A.summary: Complete connectivity, short oscillator and bypass loops, and two-sided heat spreading at U1 make A the release candidate. The long edge-parallel SCL run and interrupted SPI returns are its main electrical weaknesses.

B.summary: Dual ground pours, 132 GND vias and local MCU bypassing give B the best ground distribution. Limited U1 heat spreading, ten via drills centred in SMD lands, and the long edge-routed AREF trace cost it first place.

C.summary: Refilling leaves 58 missing connections, including both main oscillator nets, seven +5V links and seven GND links. The USB lengths look close, but the long bottom sections have poor coupling and little opposite ground.

D.summary: The board connects all nets and gives the regulator generous copper, but U3 has long bypass and resonator loops and obscures FID4. Refilling clears 499 zone-clearance errors and still leaves 16 DRC errors.

human_guess.why: The pin-bank fan-out from the central MCU follows the header rows in coherent groups. The locally shaped regulator copper, repeated large via sizes and indicator placement aligned to the legends also suggest a single designer planned the routing and placement together.
